title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-27

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Red Rocks show with a psychedelic second set and a solid soundboard source that suffers from early hiss and mix imbalance
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – the Terrapin Station/Playin' in the Band sequence, a gorgeous Stella Blue reprise and an inspired The Other One make the second set a standout.  Recording-wise the sbd capture clears up after the opening hiss, but listeners note Jerry’s guitar buried low while Brent’s keys are pushed forward, giving the mix a uneven feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated very high (many 5‑star comments) while recording quality is noted as only fair due to hiss and balance issues; weighted average yields ~4.3 stars

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable hiss at the start that clears up later; mix imbalance with Jerry's guitar low and Brent's keyboards high; overall listenable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set stays psychedelic from start to finish, weaving long jams that flow smoothly; first set solid but less highlighted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar often buried low in the mix; midi work praised but sounds distant.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as high and great, with unique moments on The Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard work is highlighted as spectacular yet turned up too high in the mix.
